pages.text: $(thing)The Big Rip$(): phantom dark energy (w < −1) grows denser as space grows. With w = −1.5 the Rip comes 22 billion years from now: clusters go a billion years before, the Solar System three months before, atoms in the last instant. The $(item)Dark Energy Siphon$() bottles it in a $(item)Phantom Energy Cell$().

$(thing)The Big Crunch$(): expansion reverses and everything falls together. In loop quantum cosmology the Friedmann equation gains a factor (1 − ρ/ρ_c): at the Planck density gravity repels and the collapse $(thing)bounces$(). The $(item)Neutron Star Forge$() crushes spin foam and degenerate matter into a $(item)Bounce Core$().

$(thing)Vacuum Decay$(): a bubble of the true vacuum needs a radius 2σ/ε to grow; bigger, it expands at nearly the speed of light, and inside it chemistry is impossible. The $(item)Higgs Field Modulator$() holds a $(item)True Vacuum Seed$() just below the critical radius. Please keep it there.
